requirements.requirement: The system must invoke the specialty match scoring logic for each provider included in the Evaluate Care response.
The system must include a specialty_match object in the provider evaluation response conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-SPC-001.
The system must populate specialty_match.requested_specialty using the normalized user input passed into the evaluation flow.
The system must populate specialty_match.matched_nucc_codes using outputs from the specialty scoring logic.
The system must include a specialty_match.score field with a numeric value between 0 and 1 for each provider.
The system must include specialty_match.explanation metadata describing how the score was derived (e.g., exact, partial, inferred match).
The system must preserve backward compatibility by not removing or altering existing fields in the Evaluate Care response.
The system must integrate specialty scoring without increasing Evaluate Care facade response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined by existing service behavior.
The system must ensure that specialty_match is computed using the same provider data used in provider detail lookup within the facade.
The system must handle multiple providers in a single request and return a distinct specialty_match object for each provider.
The system must gracefully handle missing or null provider specialty data by returning a specialty_match.score of 0 and an explanation indicating no data available.

The system must handle failures in the specialty scoring logic by returning a specialty_match object with score set to 0 and an explanation indicating scoring failure without breaking the overall response.
The system must ensure deterministic scoring output for identical inputs within the same execution context.
The system must ensure that specialty_match scoring reflects weighted logic outputs from EVAL-SPC-002 (exact, partial, inferred) without modification in the facade layer.
The system must structure the response so that specialty_match is included in all evaluation orchestration paths that return provider data.
